name.description: Plugin name. MUST equal the file stem of plugins/<name>.yaml and the last path segment of ref.

summary.description: One-line summary shown by `lfed plugin list`.

homepage.description: URL of the plugin source or documentation.

owner.description: GitHub org/team or user login that owns the plugin.

ref.description: OCI repository without tag or digest. No ':' or '@' is allowed.

signer.description: Sigstore keyless identity that signs every release of the plugin.

issuer.description: OIDC issuer URL in the signing certificate.

identity.description: Exact certificate SAN. MUST contain {version}. MAY contain {name}. Not a regexp.

title: lfed plugin catalog entry
description: One plugin entry. Source files plugins/<name>.yaml use this schema.
